lessonTitle: 48. Coordinates of the midpoint of a segment
lessonTitleEnglish: Coordinates of the midpoint of a segment
unit: Geometry · Chapter 6. Coordinates and vectors in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The midpoint M of AB has x = (x₁ + x₂)/2, y = (y₁ + y₂)/2, z = (z₁ + z₂)/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: The midpoint M of AB has x = (x₁ + x₂)/2, y = (y₁ + y₂)/2, z = (z₁ + z₂)/2.

stages.headline: The point C symmetric to A about B is C = 2B − A, since B is the midpoint of AC; e.g. A(1; 2; 3), B(2; 2; 2) gives C(3; 2; 1).
stages.headlineEnglish: The point C symmetric to A about B is C = 2B − A, since B is the midpoint of AC; e.g. A(1; 2; 3), B(2; 2; 2) gives C(3; 2; 1).

stages.headline: Reflecting in a coordinate plane changes the sign of one coordinate, about an axis of two.
